articles.summary: On February 11th, it was announced that Duolingo’s mascot - our beloved owl Duo, is dead. In the official statement, Duolingo reveals that Duo has ‘probably died waiting for you to do your lesson’. There had been many speculations around the cause of death, but what if Duo has faked their own murder? To find out,
articles.title: Duolingo’s Owl is Dead! Your Inbox is the Crime Scene
